name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short text label that appears on hover or keyboard focus, built on Radix Tooltip with a theme-inverted bubble and arrow.
author: Design From <https://labs.designfrom.com>

props.name: TooltipProvider.delayDuration
props.description: Milliseconds the pointer must rest before the tooltip opens.

props.name: TooltipContent.sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels between the trigger and the content.

a11y: Opens on keyboard focus as well as hover, and Escape closes it.
The content is linked to its trigger with aria-describedby, so screen readers announce it as a description.
Use it for supplementary text only; never put interactive controls or essential information in a tooltip.
Enter and exit animations are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
